text:
maya: rolling a config-only change to routing weights + batching for the daytime canary window. small changes, aiming for lower p95. will run 5% canary for 15m and watch p95/5xx/kvcache.

deploy-bot: queued config-change 1729991234 by maya on service=model-router. canary target=5%. change window=15m.

maya: diff pasted below — tiny and conservative. if anything spikes we rollback immediately.

maya: ```yaml
routing:
  primary_traffic_pct: 88  # 88 -> 90 for low-cost tier shift
  fallback_traffic_pct: 12  # 12 -> 10
batching:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25  # 25 -> 15
  max_batch_tokens: 512
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 30000  # unchanged
  per_token_timeout_ms: 45  # 45 -> 50 (slightly looser to avoid tail cancellations)
```

cheng: noted. small headroom on per_token_timeout to avoid OOMs makes sense with smaller batches. I'll keep an eye on kvcache hit rate — if that drops we may need to nudge batch size back.

ben: watching logs and the canary dashboards. I'll alert if p95 > 220ms for 3 consecutive minutes or 5xx rate > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: deploy started to canary (5%) at 1729991250. linking rollout run: https://deploys.internal/runs/1729991250 :rocket:

maya: thanks. also pinning model-version=stable-2026-03-20 for this route so we don't get accidental model rollups during the canary.

ben: quick checklist: metrics (p95, p50, 5xx), traces (token-duration), kvcache-hit, and queue depth. I have the alert snooze for noisy infra alerts.

cheng: if kvcache-hit drops more than 7ppt, suggest revert. otherwise keep 15m window then ramp to 25% if green.

maya: agreed. rollback criteria: p95 > 220ms for 3m OR 5xx > 0.5% for 2m OR kvcache-hit drop > 7ppt sustained 5m. Ramp criteria: stable for full 15m, p95 within 10% of baseline, 5xx < 0.2%.

deploy-bot: canary reached 5% at 1729991255. monitoring hooks enabled.

ben: saw a small p95 blip at +30s (200ms -> 240ms) but dropped back under threshold within 40s. not worrying yet.

maya: good. keeping the pin and the soft routing change only. will post release notes after the 25% ramp.

deploy-bot: canary marked healthy at 1729991289. recommended ramp to 25%.

maya: ramping to 25% now. if anyone sees anything immediate ping here and we abort. :thumbsup:

ben: on it, monitoring.

cheng: watching kvcache and batch sizes. all green so far.

maya: final note for release notes: config-only: routing weight bump, max_batch_latency reduced to 15ms, per_token_timeout slight increase. goal: improve average latency & cost per token while keeping tail stable. no model or code changes.

ben: adding a small line to changelog and the runbook.

maya: thanks team — will close thread after 1h of stable metrics.
